name: Semjon Baburin
source:
Semyon is a thirteen—year-old boy, of medium height, with short-cropped red hair and gray eyes. A fat, even obese, pimply teenager with bitten nails and rotten teeth. Semyon is wearing a shirt with two chest pockets, jeans, and black dutiki boots, and a geometric-patterned signet ring is worn on the ring finger of his left hand.

Outside, Semyon wears a black mink hat with earflaps, a warm dark brown sheepskin coat, and a beige scarf.
